content.title: About
content.content: The frozen coffee drink, decaffeinated and nonfat, is a ready‑to‑serve beverage made from filtered coffee, water and a small amount of sweetener. The coffee undergoes a decaffeination process that removes almost all caffeine, and the fat is completely removed, resulting in a low‑calorie drink.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeination is usually performed by water‑based extraction or supercritical CO₂, preserving most flavor compounds.
Frozen coffee drinks are popular in hot climates where they are served as a refreshing dessert.
The nonfat version contains less than 0.5 g of fat per 100 ml, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.
Taste of decaffeinated frozen coffee is often described as smoother and slightly sweeter than regular iced coffee.
These drinks are sometimes fortified with B‑vitamins and calcium to boost nutritional value.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: With virtually no fat and modest sugar levels, the drink fits well into weight‑management plans.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Coffee is rich in polyphenols that help combat oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: The majority of the beverage is water, contributing to daily fluid intake.

items.title: No stimulant effect
items.content: Absence of caffeine makes it safe for people sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Fortified with vitamins
items.content: Some formulations add vitamin D and calcium, beneficial for bone health.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to coffee components.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Certain versions contain added sweeteners; people with diabetes should check the label.

items.title: Cold temperature
items.content: Consuming directly from the freezer can cause discomfort for those with sensitive teeth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the frozen coffee straight from the freezer, allowing it to soften for 2–3 minutes for a smoother texture. You can garnish with fresh berries, mint, or a sprinkle of cinnamon. It works as a snack dessert or a post‑workout refresher.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a freezer at –18 °C or lower in the original packaging. Once opened, use within 2–3 weeks to prevent crystal formation and flavor loss. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 30 minutes.
